854844.name: YVH1
854844.summary: Enables preribosome binding activity and protein tyrosine phosphatase activity. Involved in several processes, including ascospore wall assembly; double-strand break repair via break-induced replication; and ribosome biogenesis. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human DUSP12 (dual specificity phosphatase 12). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854852.name: LYS1
854852.summary: Enables mRNA binding activity and saccharopine dehydrogenase (NAD+, L-lysine-forming) activity. Involved in L-lysine biosynthetic process. Acts upstream of or within protein import into peroxisome matrix. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854878.name: RAD10
854878.summary: Enables single-stranded DNA binding activity. Contributes to single-stranded DNA endonuclease activity. Involved in DNA metabolic process. Located in nucleus. Part of nucleotide-excision repair factor 1 complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including azoospermia; carcinoma (multiple); cerebrooculofacioskeletal syndrome 4; gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); and hematologic cancer (multiple). Orthologous to human ERCC1 (ERCC excision repair 1, endonuclease non-catalytic subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854893.name: ATP18
854893.summary: Contributes to proton-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism. Involved in mitochondrial proton-transporting ATP synthase complex assembly and proton motive force-driven ATP synthesis. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of proton-transporting ATP synthase complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854902.name: RPL6A
854902.summary: Enables RNA binding activity. A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation and ribosomal large subunit assembly. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL6 (ribosomal protein L6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854903.name: TCB3
854903.summary: Enables phospholipid binding activity. Involved in endoplasmic reticulum membrane organization; intermembrane phospholipid transfer; and regulation of phosphatidylinositol dephosphorylation. Acts upstream of or within ER to Golgi ceramide transport and phospholipid homeostasis. Located in cellular bud and cortical endoplasmic reticulum. Orthologous to human ESYT1 (extended synaptotagmin 1) and ESYT2 (extended synaptotagmin 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854909.name: ERO1
854909.summary: Enables thiol oxidase activity. Involved in protein folding in endoplasmic reticulum. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Orthologous to human ERO1A (endoplasmic reticulum oxidoreductase 1 alpha) and ERO1B (endoplasmic reticulum oxidoreductase 1 beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854914.name: PGA3
854914.summary: Enables cytochrome-b5 reductase activity, acting on NAD(P)H. Involved in protein transport. Located in plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer and methemoglobinemia. Orthologous to human CYB5R1 (cytochrome b5 reductase 1) and CYB5R3 (cytochrome b5 reductase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854916.name: PHO84
854916.summary: Enables manganese ion transmembrane transporter activity; phosphate transmembrane transporter activity; and selenite:proton symporter activity. Involved in several processes, including phosphate ion transport; plasma membrane selenite transport; and polyphosphate metabolic process. Located in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854918.name: GTR1
854918.summary: Enables GTPase activity and identical protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA-templated transcription; positive regulation of TORC1 signaling; and subtelomeric heterochromatin formation. Acts upstream of or within cellular response to oxidative stress. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane; late endosome membrane; and nucleus. Part of Gtr1-Gtr2 GTPase complex and Ragulator complex. Orthologous to several human genes including RRAGA (Ras related GTP binding A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854919.name: NDI1
854919.summary: Enables NADH dehydrogenase (ubiquinone) (non-electrogenic) activity and identical protein binding activity. Involved in mitochondrial electron transport, NADH to ubiquinone and positive regulation of apoptotic process. Located in mitochondrial matrix. Used to study Leber hereditary optic neuropathy. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854929.name: BUL2
854929.summary: Enables ubiquitin-ubiquitin ligase activity. Involved in protein monoubiquitination and protein polyubiquitination. Located in cytoplasm. Part of ubiquitin ligase complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854930.name: COQ5
854930.summary: Enables 2-methoxy-6-polyprenyl-1,4-benzoquinol methyltransferase activity. Involved in aerobic respiration; methylation; and ubiquinone biosynthetic process. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane and mitochondrial matrix. Used to study coenzyme Q10 deficiency disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary coenzyme Q10 deficiency 9. Orthologous to human COQ5 (coenzyme Q5, methyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854931.name: ZDS2
854931.summary: Involved in several processes, including establishment of cell polarity; positive regulation of G2/M transition of mitotic cell cycle; and rDNA heterochromatin formation. Located in cellular bud neck; cellular bud tip; and cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854939.name: RPS1B
854939.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Part of 90S preribosome. Orthologous to human RPS3A (ribosomal protein S3A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854954.name: GAL80
854954.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity; identical protein binding activity; and kinase inhibitor activity. Involved in galactose metabolic process; negative regulation of phosphorylation; and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854973.name: AMD1
854973.summary: Enables AMP deaminase activity. Involved in guanine salvage and purine nucleotide metabolic process. Located in cytoplasm. Used to study pontocerebellar hypoplasia. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congestive heart failure; coronary artery disease; hereditary spastic paraplegia 63; left ventricular failure; and pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 9. Orthologous to human AMPD1 (adenosine monophosphate deaminase 1); AMPD2 (adenosine monophosphate deaminase 2); and AMPD3 (adenosine monophosphate deaminase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854976.name: RAD52
854976.summary: Enables DNA strand exchange activity and DNA/DNA annealing activity. Involved in DNA metabolic process. Located in nuclear chromosome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); lung cancer (multiple); mucoepidermoid carcinoma; and nicotine dependence. Orthologous to human RAD52 (RAD52 DNA repair protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854980.name: TSA1
854980.summary: Enables several functions, including identical protein binding activity; thioredoxin peroxidase activity; and unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA protection; cell redox homeostasis; and cellular response to dithiothreitol. Located in cytosol. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 32 and methylmalonic aciduria and homocystinuria type cblC. Orthologous to several human genes including PRDX1 (peroxiredoxin 1) and PRDX2 (peroxiredoxin 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854982.name: RPS18B
854982.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in endonucleolytic cleavage in ITS1 to separate SSU-rRNA from 5.8S rRNA and LSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA) and ribosomal subunit export from nucleus. Located in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human RPS18 (ribosomal protein S18). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854984.name: RPS17A
854984.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Predicted to be part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-Blackfan anemia 4. Orthologous to human RPS17 (ribosomal protein S17). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854986.name: APT1
854986.summary: Enables adenine phosphoribosyltransferase activity. Involved in adenine salvage. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in adenine phosphoribosyltransferase deficiency. Orthologous to human APRT (adenine phosphoribosyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854992.name: PPZ1
854992.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity. Involved in intracellular protein localization and intracellular sodium ion homeostasis. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854994.name: TRM9
854994.summary: Enables tRNA (uridine) methyltransferase activity. Involved in regulation of translational elongation; tRNA methylation; and tRNA wobble uridine modification. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder 71. Orthologous to several human genes including ALKBH8 (alkB homolog 8, tRNA methyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854995.name: UBX2
854995.summary: Enables protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in lipid droplet organization; mitochondrial protein processing; and proteasomal protein catabolic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane; lipid droplet; and plasma membrane. Part of Doa10p ubiquitin ligase complex and Hrd1p ubiquitin ligase ERAD-L complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855002.name: MRPL39
855002.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPL33 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L33). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855003.name: ERG6
855003.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and sterol 24-C-methyltransferase activity. Involved in ergosterol biosynthetic process. Located in lipid droplet. Is active in endoplasmic reticulum. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855012.name: YPT7
855012.summary: Enables GTPase activity. Involved in several processes, including cytoplasm to vacuole targeting by the Cvt pathway; piecemeal microautophagy of the nucleus; and vacuole inheritance. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane; multivesicular body; and vacuole-mitochondrion membrane contact site. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2B. Orthologous to several human genes including RAB7A (RAB7A, member RAS oncogene family). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855022.name: ANY1
855022.summary: Enables phospholipid scramblase activity. Involved in multivesicular body assembly; phospholipid translocation; and retrograde transport, endosome to Golgi. Located in endosome membrane and trans-Golgi network membrane. Is active in early endosome. Orthologous to human SLC66A2 (solute carrier family 66 member 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855029.name: ERG5
855029.summary: Enables C-22 sterol desaturase (NADPH) activity. Involved in ergosterol biosynthetic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Orthologous to human CYP26A1 (cytochrome P450 family 26 subfamily A member 1) and CYP26B1 (cytochrome P450 family 26 subfamily B member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855032.name: PEX9
855032.summary: Predicted to enable peroxisome matrix targeting signal-1 binding activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in protein import into peroxisome matrix. Located in cytosol and peroxisomal membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in peroxisome biogenesis disorder 2A; peroxisome biogenesis disorder 2B; and rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata type 5. Orthologous to human PEX5 (peroxisomal biogenesis factor 5) and PEX5L (peroxisomal biogenesis factor 5 like). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855044.name: FAR8
855044.summary: Predicted to enable protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in re-entry into mitotic cell cycle after pheromone arrest. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Orthologous to human STRN (striatin). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855054.name: CCS1
855054.summary: Enables superoxide dismutase copper chaperone activity. Involved in copper ion transport; double-strand break repair via break-induced replication; and removal of superoxide radicals. Located in cytosol; mitochondrial inner membrane; and nucleus. Used to study amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; cataract; neurodegenerative disease; and sensorineural hearing loss. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Orthologous to human CCS (copper chaperone for superoxide dismutase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855080.name: FET3
855080.summary: Enables ferroxidase activity. Contributes to iron ion transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in several processes, including arsenate ion transmembrane transport; intracellular copper ion homeostasis; and iron ion transport. Located in plasma membrane. Part of high-affinity iron permease complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855086.name: AEP1
855086.summary: Enables translation regulator activity. Involved in regulation of translation. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855088.name: SOV1
855088.summary: Enables translation activator activity. Involved in mitochondrial translation. Acts upstream of or within mitochondrial ribosome assembly. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855089.name: UBX4
855089.summary: Involved in ERAD pathway and sporulation resulting in formation of a cellular spore. Located in nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in alveolar soft part sarcoma. Orthologous to human ASPSCR1 (ASPSCR1 tether for SLC2A4, UBX domain containing). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855091.name: NAT4
855091.summary: Enables histone H2A acetyltransferase activity and histone H4 acetyltransferase activity. Involved in heterochromatin formation. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human NAA40 (N-alpha-acetyltransferase 40, NatD catalytic subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855101.name: VPS20
855101.summary: Involved in several processes, including ATP export; double-strand break repair via break-induced replication; and intralumenal vesicle formation. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Part of ESCRT III complex. Is active in cytosol. Orthologous to human CHMP6 (charged multivesicular body protein 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855108.name: YMR084W
855108.summary: Predicted to enable L-glutamine:D-fructose-6-phosphate transaminase (isomerizing) activity. Predicted to be involved in UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthetic process. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital myasthenic syndrome 12 and obesity. Orthologous to human GFPT1 (glutamine--fructose-6-phosphate transaminase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855125.name: YMR099C
855125.summary: Enables glucose-6-phosphate 1-epimerase activity. Predicted to be involved in carbohydrate metabolic process. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855126.name: MUB1
855126.summary: Predicted to enable zinc ion binding activity. Involved in double-strand break repair via break-induced replication; protein ubiquitination; and ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Part of MUB1-RAD6-UBR2 ubiquitin ligase complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855132.name: YKU80
855132.summary: Enables telomerase RNA binding activity and telomeric repeat DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA metabolic process; establishment of protein-containing complex localization to telomere; and subtelomeric heterochromatin formation. Located in chromosome, telomeric region. Part of Ku70:Ku80 complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease; multiple myeloma; and rectum cancer. Orthologous to human XRCC5 (X-ray repair cross complementing 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855149.name: ADE17
855149.summary: Enables IMP cyclohydrolase activity and phosphoribosylaminoimidazolecarboxamide formyltransferase activity. Involved in 'de novo' IMP biosynthetic process. Located in cytosol. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in purine-pyrimidine metabolic disorder. Orthologous to human ATIC (5-aminoimidazole-4-carboxamide ribonucleotide formyltransferase/IMP cyclohydrolase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855166.name: GID8
855166.summary: Predicted to enable protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in negative regulation of gluconeogenesis; proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process; and traversing start control point of mitotic cell cycle. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Part of GID complex. Orthologous to human GID8 (GID complex subunit 8 homolog). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855170.name: RIM11
855170.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in ascospore formation. Located in cytoplasm. Is active in nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer's disease; amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; bipolar disorder; oral squamous cell carcinoma; and schizophrenia. Orthologous to several human genes including GSK3B (glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855173.name: RPL13B
855173.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in macroautophagy. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL13 (ribosomal protein L13). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855176.name: NDE1
855176.summary: Enables NADH dehydrogenase activity. Involved in pyruvate fermentation to ethanol and regulation of apoptotic process. Located in mitochondrial membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855189.name: AIM36
855189.summary: Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855194.name: ATG16
855194.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Contributes to Atg8-family ligase activity. Involved in several processes, including C-terminal protein lipidation; cytoplasm to vacuole targeting by the Cvt pathway; and macroautophagy. Located in phagophore; phagophore assembly site; and vacuole-isolation membrane contact site. Part of Atg12-Atg5-Atg16 complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855202.name: MME1
855202.summary: Enables magnesium ion transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in magnesium ion export from mitochondrion. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855205.name: ALD3
855205.summary: Enables aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity. Involved in beta-alanine biosynthetic process and polyamine catabolic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including alcohol dependence; alcohol use disorder; artery disease (multiple); diabetes mellitus (multiple); and liver disease (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including ALDH1A1 (aldehyde dehydrogenase 1 family member A1); ALDH1A2 (aldehyde dehydrogenase 1 family member A2); and ALDH1A3 (aldehyde dehydrogenase 1 family member A3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855213.name: SIP18
855213.summary: Enables phospholipid binding activity. Involved in cellular response to water deprivation. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855221.name: SSO2
855221.summary: Enables SNAP receptor activity and phosphatidic acid binding activity. Involved in ascospore-type prospore assembly; maintenance of protein location in plasma membrane; and vesicle fusion. Located in plasma membrane and prospore membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease and Hirschsprung's disease. Orthologous to several human genes including STX1A (syntaxin 1A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855222.name: ADD37
855222.summary: Involved in ERAD pathway. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855228.name: SGS1
855228.summary: Enables 3'-5' DNA helicase activity and DNA topoisomerase binding activity. Involved in DNA metabolic process; nuclear chromosome segregation; and regulation of cell cycle process. Located in nucleus. Part of RecQ family helicase-topoisomerase III complex. Is active in nucleolus. Used to study Bloom syndrome and Werner syndrome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Bloom syndrome. Orthologous to human BLM (BLM RecQ like helicase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855231.name: MRPL24
855231.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPL28 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L28). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855247.name: HFA1
855247.summary: Enables acetyl-CoA carboxylase activity. Involved in long-chain fatty acid biosynthetic process. Located in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human ACACA (acetyl-CoA carboxylase alpha) and ACACB (acetyl-CoA carboxylase beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855254.name: SCJ1
855254.summary: Enables protein-folding chaperone binding activity. Involved in ERAD pathway; protein folding in endoplasmic reticulum; and response to unfolded protein. Located in endoplasmic reticulum lumen. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in polycystic kidney disease 6. Orthologous to human DNAJB11 (DnaJ heat shock protein family (Hsp40) member B11). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855263.name: UBP8
855263.summary: Enables cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity and molecular adaptor activity. Involved in RNA splicing and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Part of DUBm complex; SAGA complex; and SLIK (SAGA-like) complex. Used to study glioblastoma. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in non-syndromic X-linked intellectual disability 105. Orthologous to several human genes including USP27X (ubiquitin specific peptidase 27 X-linked). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855264.name: MRE11
855264.summary: Enables DNA binding activity; DNA nuclease activity; and molecular adaptor activity. Contributes to AMP kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA metabolic process; R-loop processing; and ascospore formation. Located in nucleus. Part of Mre11 complex. Used to study breast cancer; intestinal cancer; liver cancer; ovarian cancer; and skin cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Lynch syndrome; ataxia-telangiectasia-like disorder 1; endometrial cancer; gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); and urinary bladder cancer. Orthologous to human MRE11 (MRE11 double strand break repair nuclease). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855270.name: RPS10B
855270.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cellular response to amino acid starvation; positive regulation of protein kinase activity; and ribosomal subunit export from nucleus. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Predicted to be part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-Blackfan anemia 9. Orthologous to several human genes including RPS10 (ribosomal protein S10). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855283.name: RPL20A
855283.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL18A (ribosomal protein L18a). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855287.name: COA6
855287.summary: Enables copper ion binding activity and protein-disulfide reductase activity. Involved in intracellular copper ion homeostasis and mitochondrial respiratory chain complex IV assembly. Located in mitochondrial intermembrane space. Used to study COX deficiency, infantile mitochondrial myopathy; cardiomyopathy; and cytochrome-c oxidase deficiency disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial complex IV deficiency nuclear type 13. Orthologous to human COA6 (cytochrome c oxidase assembly factor 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855289.name: RKR1
855289.summary: Enables ribosomal large subunit binding activity and ubiquitin protein ligase activity. Involved in several processes, including rescue of stalled cytosolic ribosome; ribosome-associated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process; and subtelomeric heterochromatin formation. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Part of RQC complex. Is active in cytosolic ribosome. Orthologous to human LTN1 (listerin E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855299.name: PET111
855299.summary: Enables translation regulator activity. Involved in mitochondrial respiratory chain complex IV assembly and positive regulation of mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855300.name: ROY1
855300.summary: Enables GTPase inhibitor activity. Involved in endocytosis and protein targeting to vacuole. Located in endoplasmic reticulum and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855305.name: SAP30
855305.summary: Enables transcription corepressor activity. Involved in several processes, including double-strand break repair via break-induced replication; positive regulation of invasive growth in response to glucose limitation; and regulation of gene expression. Part of Rpd3L complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855309.name: PPA2
855309.summary: Enables inorganic diphosphate phosphatase activity. Involved in aerobic respiration. Located in mitochondrion. Used to study dilated cardiomyopathy and myocarditis. Orthologous to human PPA1 (inorganic pyrophosphatase 1) and PPA2 (inorganic pyrophosphatase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855316.name: ZDS1
855316.summary: Enables protein phosphatase inhibitor activity. Involved in several processes, including heterochromatin formation; mRNA export from nucleus; and positive regulation of G2/M transition of mitotic cell cycle. Located in several cellular components, including cellular bud neck; cellular bud tip; and incipient cellular bud site. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855328.name: YKU70
855328.summary: Enables telomerase RNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including constitutive heterochromatin formation; double-strand break repair; and establishment of protein-containing complex localization to telomere. Located in nuclear envelope. Part of Ku70:Ku80 complex. Orthologous to human XRCC6 (X-ray repair cross complementing 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855330.name: MRPL33
855330.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855331.name: DSS1
855331.summary: Enables exoribonuclease II activity. Involved in mitochondrial RNA catabolic process. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial degradosome. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855338.name: HER2
855338.summary: Enables glutaminyl-tRNA synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity. Involved in endoplasmic reticulum organization and glutaminyl-tRNAGln biosynthesis via transamidation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of glutamyl-tRNA(Gln) amidotransferase complex. Used to study cardiomyopathy. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 40. Orthologous to human QRSL1 (glutaminyl-tRNA amidotransferase subunit QRSL1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855339.name: JNM1
855339.summary: A structural constituent of cytoskeleton. Involved in double-strand break repair via break-induced replication; establishment of mitotic spindle orientation; and nuclear migration. Part of dynactin complex. Orthologous to human DCTN2 (dynactin subunit 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855346.name: ADE4
855346.summary: Enables amidophosphoribosyltransferase activity. Involved in 'de novo' IMP biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human PPAT (phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate amidotransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855349.name: ADH2
855349.summary: Enables alcohol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity. Involved in amino acid catabolic process to alcohol via Ehrlich pathway and ethanol metabolic process. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855355.name: GAS1
855355.summary: Enables 1,3-beta-glucanosyltransferase activity. Involved in several processes, including fungal-type cell wall organization; heterochromatin formation; and regulation of response to endoplasmic reticulum stress. Located in several cellular components, including COPII-coated ER to Golgi transport vesicle; cellular bud scar; and primary cell septum. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855361.name: TGL3
855361.summary: Enables lysophosphatidylethanolamine acyltransferase activity and triacylglycerol lipase activity. Involved in cell budding and triglyceride catabolic process. Located in lipid droplet. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855386.name: RPD3
855386.summary: Enables histone deacetylase activity; transcription coactivator activity; and transcription corepressor activity. Involved in several processes, including mitotic cell cycle phase transition; nucleolus organization; and regulation of gene expression. Located in nuclear periphery. Part of Rpd3L complex and Rpd3S complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in stomach cancer. Orthologous to human HDAC1 (histone deacetylase 1) and HDAC2 (histone deacetylase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855387.name: PEX6
855387.summary: Enables ATP hydrolysis activity and protein transporter activity. Contributes to membrane protein dislocase activity. Involved in protein import into peroxisome matrix, receptor recycling and protein unfolding. Located in cytosol and peroxisome. Part of ATPase complex. Used to study peroxisomal biogenesis disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Heimler syndrome 2; Peroxisome biogenesis disorder 4B; and peroxisome biogenesis disorder 4A. Orthologous to human PEX6 (peroxisomal biogenesis factor 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855390.name: PFA3
855390.summary: Enables palmitoyltransferase activity. Involved in protein palmitoylation and vacuole fusion, non-autophagic. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Orthologous to several human genes including ZDHHC20 (zDHHC palmitoyltransferase 20). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855392.name: FIG4
855392.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol-3,5-bisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity. Involved in phosphatidylinositol dephosphorylation. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane and nuclear periphery. Part of PAS complex. Used to study Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 4J; Yunis-Varon syndrome; amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 11; and bilateral parasagittal parieto-occipital polymicrogyria. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 4J; Yunis-Varon syndrome; amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 11; and bilateral parasagittal parieto-occipital polymicrogyria. Orthologous to human FIG4 (FIG4 phosphoinositide 5-phosphatase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855418.name: CLA4
855418.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of sterol import; organelle inheritance; and regulation of gene expression. Located in cellular bud; fungal-type vacuole; and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer; ductal carcinoma in situ; non-syndromic X-linked intellectual disability 30; renal cell carcinoma (multiple); and schizophrenia. Orthologous to several human genes including BUB1B-PAK6 (BUB1B-PAK6 readthrough); PAK1 (p21 (RAC1) activated kinase 1); and PAK2 (p21 (RAC1) activated kinase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855420.name: MON2
855420.summary: Enables guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Involved in cytosolic transport; endocytosis; and protein targeting to vacuole. Located in early endosome membrane and trans-Golgi network. Orthologous to human MON2 (MON2 regulator of endosome-to-Golgi trafficking). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855441.name: ERG24
855441.summary: Enables Delta14-sterol reductase activity. Involved in ergosterol biosynthetic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Greenberg dysplasia; Pelger-Huet anomaly; and primary biliary cholangitis. Orthologous to human LBR (lamin B receptor) and TM7SF2 (transmembrane 7 superfamily member 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855444.name: MET2
855444.summary: Enables homoserine O-acetyltransferase activity. Involved in L-homoserine metabolic process and L-methionine biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855450.name: BNI1
855450.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and profilin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including barbed-end actin filament capping; budding cell apical bud growth; and cytoskeleton organization. Located in several cellular components, including actin filament; cellular bud tip; and incipient cellular bud site. Part of polarisome. Is active in cytosol and mating projection tip. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in auditory system disease (multiple); nephrotic syndrome type 24; and primary ovarian insufficiency (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including DIAPH1 (diaphanous related formin 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855464.name: SIP3
855464.summary: Enables transcription coregulator activity. Involved in intracellular sterol transport and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in cortical endoplasmic reticulum. Is active in cortical endoplasmic reticulum membrane and perinuclear endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Orthologous to human CCNY (cyclin Y). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855469.name: MRPL17
855469.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPL46 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L46). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855471.name: RAD50
855471.summary: Enables AMP kinase activity; ATP hydrolysis activity; and DNA binding activity. Involved in DNA metabolic process; R-loop processing; and homologous chromosome pairing at meiosis. Located in nucleus. Part of Mre11 complex. Used to study breast cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in transitional cell carcinoma. Orthologous to human RAD50 (RAD50 double strand break repair protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855475.name: VPS75
855475.summary: Enables several functions, including H3-H4 histone complex chaperone activity; acetyltransferase activator activity; and identical protein binding activity. Involved in DNA replication-dependent chromatin assembly; double-strand break repair via nonhomologous end joining; and nucleosome assembly. Located in chromatin; cytosol; and nucleus. Part of H3 histone acetyltransferase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 58; gonadal dysgenesis; prostate cancer; and sudden infant death syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including SETSIP (SET like protein); SET (SET nuclear proto-oncogene); and TSPYL1 (TSPY like 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855479.name: ATG2
855479.summary: Enables lipid transfer activity and phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding activity. Involved in autophagy of mitochondrion; cytoplasm to vacuole targeting by the Cvt pathway; and macroautophagy. Located in phagophore and phagophore assembly site membrane. Is extrinsic component of phagophore assembly site membrane. Orthologous to several human genes including ATG2B (autophagy related 2B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855480.name: ZWF1
855480.summary: Enables glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase activity. Involved in pentose-phosphate shunt, oxidative branch and response to hydrogen peroxide. Located in cytoplasm. Used to study congenital nonspherocytic hemolytic anemia. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in anemia (multiple); cerebrovascular disease; diabetes mellitus; malaria (multiple); and neonatal jaundice. Orthologous to human G6PD (glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855483.name: KEX2
855483.summary: Enables serine-type endopeptidase activity. Involved in peptide pheromone maturation. Located in trans-Golgi network. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in colorectal adenocarcinoma; obesity; and proprotein convertase 1/3 deficiency. Orthologous to several human genes including PCSK7 (proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855492.name: URE2
855492.summary: Enables glutathione peroxidase activity and phosphoprotein binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; protein urmylation; and regulation of nitrogen utilization. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855501.name: ADE12
855501.summary: Enables DNA replication origin binding activity and adenylosuccinate synthase activity. Involved in purine nucleotide biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to several human genes including ADSS2 (adenylosuccinate synthase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855508.name: RRG9
855508.summary: Involved in mitochondrial DNA metabolic process and mitochondrion organization. Located in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human NGRN (neugrin, neurite outgrowth associated). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

855518.name: SPS19
855518.summary: Enables 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase (NADPH) activity. Involved in ascospore formation and fatty acid catabolic process. Located in peroxisomal matrix. Orthologous to human DECR2 (2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

855524.name: WHI3
855524.summary: Enables mRNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including invasive growth in response to glucose limitation; positive regulation of cell size; and regulation of gene expression. Located in P-body; cytoplasmic stress granule; and endoplasmic reticulum membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]
